description: This source file implements training logic for machine learning models within a data processing project. It includes functions for data ingestion, feature preparation, model training and evaluation, and artifact storage, along with data structures for metadata.

classes.name: TrainingResult
classes.description: Data model representing the result and metadata of a trained machine learning model.

methods.description: Infers whether the dataset target is for regression or classification based on data characteristics.

methods.description: Processes raw data to prepare feature matrix X and target vector y, including encoding and filling missing values.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame _read_uploaded_to_dataframe(file_bytes: bytes, filename: str)
methods.description: Reads uploaded binary file content into a pandas DataFrame, supporting CSV and Excel formats.

methods.name: _train_model(X: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.Series, task_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Trains a Random Forest model for classification or regression, returning the trained model, task type, and metrics.

methods.name: _to_json_safe(value)
methods.description: Converts data containing numpy types, NaN, Inf into JSON-serializable formats.

methods.name: TrainingResult _store_artifact(model, meta: Dict[str, Union[str, int, float]])
methods.description: Saves the trained model to disk and writes associated metadata to a JSON file.

methods.name: TrainingResult train_from_upload( file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, target_column: Optional[str] = None, task_type: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Main public function to process an uploaded dataset, train a model, and save artifacts. Uses heuristics to select the target column if not provided.
